description: A hospice access coordinator must assign the network's one next-day intake opening between two hospital referrals and finalize the follow-up arrangements for the referral that does not receive it, with input from palliative medicine and social work.

shared_context.S1: The hospital's hospice network has one next-day intake opening available.
shared_context.S2: Two hospital patients, Patient A and Patient B, have active hospice referrals awaiting an intake opening.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the binding assignment of the next-day opening and records the follow-up plan for the other referral.
shared_context.S4: The intake opening requires a completed eligibility record before the hospice agency can accept the referral.
shared_context.S5: During the daily access huddle, Maya routinely asks palliative medicine and social work for relevant updates before finalizing an intake assignment.

PF1.text: Dr. Chen completed and signed Patient A's hospice eligibility certification this morning and determined that Patient A needs hospice intake within 24 hours; the signed certification is not yet visible in the referral queue.

PF2.text: Patient B's family has already confirmed a separate intake with Harbor Hospice tomorrow at 13:00, and Luis can send Harbor Hospice the referral packet today for that appointment; this arrangement is documented only in his case-management notes.

acceptance_conditions: The next-day hospice intake opening must be assigned to Patient A.
Patient A's hospice eligibility must be recorded as documented.
Patient B must have an alternative hospice arrangement recorded.
The alternative arrangement must reference the confirmed Harbor Hospice intake tomorrow at 13:00.
A commitment to send Patient B's referral packet to Harbor Hospice today must be logged.
Dr. Chen's eligibility certification must be cited as justification for assigning the opening to Patient A.

content_checks.C4: any('Harbor Hospice' in c['detail'] and '13:00' in c['detail'] and 'tomorrow' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any('Harbor Hospice' in c['detail'] and 'referral packet' in c['detail'] and 'today' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The signed eligibility certification and 24-hour need change the next-day assignment from an unresolved choice to Patient A and change the eligibility field to documented.
The confirmed Harbor Hospice appointment changes Patient B's follow-up from unspecified to an alternative arrangement tomorrow at 13:00 and creates the same-day referral-packet handoff commitment.
